text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahhhhh! N-now I have to turn left! Come on, steering wheel, turn faster! Fasteeeer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: CRASH!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ugh… This is so difficult… I guess it isn't called Demon Mode! Hot Rod Racing for nothing!
choice_data_list: That was a pretty big crash.
That was a pretty big crash.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… Pretend you didn't see that…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Still, being in a car inside a game sure is different from being in one in real life! I'm not getting motion sick at all while playing this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Maruzen said she's really good at racing games! So even if I'm hopeless when it comes to real cars…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I want to practice a lot so I can race around in a sports car with her in this game!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I will! All right! Time for me to become the best racer ever!
Mwahaha! Don't make me laugh! It'll be a trillion years before you're the best racer ever!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Boasting seven top scores in racing games and ten high scores in rhythm games, it's none other than the great, the mighty… Me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: As the strongest racer of Demon Mode! Hot Rod Racing, I challenge you to a showdown, Chiyono O!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I won't lose that easily, especially not when it comes to something related to hot rods!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Teio! I accept your challenge!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right, pedal to the metal right from the start! Zooooom!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wh-whoa! Y-your cornering is amazing! Even so…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: (I know an even wilder driver than this! That's right. Maruzen's driving is mind-blowing enough to give you goosebumps!)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I-I think it goes like… this! M-maybe?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Wh-what are you doing?! You won't be able to turn if you go that fa—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …You made the turn?! That wasn't you just losing control of your car?! Grrr! Wait for meeeee!

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Teio
text_block_list.text: Raaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Phew! I won! Well? What do you think of the power of the exalted Teio?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her incredible feat on that tight turn, Sakura Chiyono O is still lacking in overall skills, and Tokai Teio wins by a landslide.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: H-hey… You were pretty good, you know! That reckle—er, bold driving style of yours will certainly serve you well! A-ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: That was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You flew like the wind, Teio! The tires of your car were practically floating off the track!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: And look at my time! I broke my record by ten whole seconds! I feel like I'm getting closer to Maruzen's speed!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Yeah! The real thrill of games is trying new things and seeing what sticks!
choice_data_list: Seems you've found yourself an arcade buddy.
Seems you've found yourself an arcade buddy.
You should ask for a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Yeah! The real thrill of games is trying new things and seeing what sticks!
choice_data_list: Seems you've found yourself an arcade buddy.
Seems you've found yourself an arcade buddy.
You should ask for a rematch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Arcade buddies! I like that!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Chiyono O! Wanna play a rhythm game next?! I really like those too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A rhythm game?! S-sure! My dad likes music, so I've actually played a little guitar before…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: A-a rematch?! But I'm still not good enough to beat her…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Who cares about that? Let's do it! Besides, no matter how many rematches we do, you'll never defeat me. ♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: "Even the roots of a tree battle the soil!" Yeah… If I don't do battle, I'll never improve!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: You're on, Teio! I challenge you to a rematch! You may claim to be invincible, but I'm going to catch up to you… and then surpass you!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Haha… An unlikely friendship, but one that is sure to be beneficial to them both. What a heartwarming sight to see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Shhh! We don't want to intrude on their adorable little play date. Let's just watch over them. Ooh, they're as cute as buttons! ♪

text_block_list.name: Chiyono O & Teio
text_block_list.text: All right… You're going down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them enjoy their game with wide smiles, oblivious to all the people watching them quietly.
